visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A split-screen visual displays a woman's back. On the left side labeled 'Before,' her long dark hair appears frizzy and dull. On the right side labeled 'After,' her hair is noticeably smoother and shinier. She runs her hands through her hair to demonstrate the texture difference against a plain indoor background with soft lighting. (2) The woman faces the camera, smiling warmly. She touches her long, dark, silky hair which looks hydrated and radiant. She is wearing a white off-the-shoulder lace top and an Apple Watch on her left wrist. The setting is a brightly lit indoor space with a neutral-colored couch in the background. (3) A close-up shot features a blue translucent bottle of 'KERASILK Hydrating Essence' on a wooden surface under natural sunlight. The sunlight creates a shadow of the bottle. (4) The scene shifts to the bathroom where the woman, wearing a white towel, pours the clear liquid product into her palm. She then applies it to her wet, dark hair, massaging it in. The background is a clean, white-tiled bathroom wall with bright indoor lighting. (5) A montage of the woman showcasing her silky hair follows, including close-ups of the hair strands reflecting light. She then demonstrates a 'cocktail treatment' by mixing a white hair mask cream in her hand with the blue essence before applying it to her hair in the shower. (6) The video concludes with another split-screen comparison of 'Before' and 'After' showing significantly improved hair quality. The woman holds the blue product bottle and smiles at the camera, framed in a medium shot within her living room setting.

The vocal is clear and well-enunciated. (2) As the speaker describes the product texture, a subtle 'liquid splash' sound effect is heard, emphasizing the pouring action. The BGM remains consistent in volume as a background bed. (3) A soft 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the scene moves to the bathroom. The speaker's voice maintains high arousal as she explains the washing steps. (4) During the application demonstration, there are minor incidental sounds of water running and hand rubbing against hair, layered beneath the dominant narration and music. (5) The video finishes with the speaker stating the product name clearly. The BGM concludes with a final acoustic strum and a logo-style 'pop' sound effect.

It aims to persuade viewers of the product's effectiveness in transforming dry, frizzy hair into silky, radiant hair through visual comparisons and a step-by-step application guide.
